notes.title: Halloween & Update 1.0.9
notes.content:
Hey folks!

We have just released the first major update for Pixel With Your Friends! For the next few weeks we will celebrate halloween with you! You will be able to visit the museum during nighttime and restore spooky artworks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307987/3cd27593b54f04ecb4388f3ea8b6ec823e25bc79.png[/img]

In your gallery you will find a door to a new room: the Showroom! Here you can set-up and customize your own showroom with restored artworks and decorations! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307987/358f27b31ea7f4628d95cdeaa5c6de780a76bd66.png[/img]

- 80 new artworks
- halloween-event
- new feature: Showroom
- new language: turkish
- lots of bug fixes and improvements!

What do you like or dislike about the new showroom? What do you think we should add as improvements?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307987/1b4a65af65a7739e654bf2b46a65be37d96cd477.png[/img]

tags.bug: - lots of bug fixes and improvements!
